name: Gradle

knownPaths.description: Gradle's dependency and build cache. Safe to delete, but the next build re-downloads every dependency — slow on a throttled connection. Also where incremental task output is stored, so deleting it costs one full rebuild.
knownPaths.inventoryDescription: modules-2/ holds downloaded jars and AARs, transforms/ holds processed copies, build-cache-1/ holds task output. The modules-2 cache is the expensive one to rebuild.

knownPaths.description: Gradle distributions fetched by the wrapper. Re-downloaded the next time ./gradlew runs. Deleting this breaks offline builds until a connection is available.
Daemon logs and registry. Read these when a build fails with a daemon error.
Gradle home. Alongside caches it holds gradle.properties, which is where signing keys and repository credentials are normally configured, plus any init scripts. Not disposable.

description: Gradle build system. Its dependency cache is regenerable but costly to rebuild without a fast connection.
